items.en_title: Side expands presence in China, opens new studio and acquires art outsourcing provider Roboto Entertainment

items.title: Netflix reportedly offered $500m to Microsoft to license Xbox IP for seven years
items.en_title: Netflix reportedly offered $500m to Microsoft to license Xbox IP for seven years
items.en_oneliner: Netflix reportedly offered $500 million for seven years of Xbox IP film and TV adaptation rights, with game IP cross-media value continuing to rise.

items.title: Build your own world in ‘Fangtopia’
items.en_oneliner: The relaxed, eerie puzzle game Fangtopia lets players build a world for monsters with hex tiles, and its small-scale building gameplay is well worth borrowing for indie developers.

items.title: Microsoft extends consultation period for Arkane Lyon as it continues development on Marvel's Blade
items.en_title: Microsoft extends consultation period for Arkane Lyon as it continues development on Marvel's Blade
items.en_oneliner: Microsoft extended Arkane Lyon's consultation period by a month, continuing to seek a buyer for the studio, with Marvel's Blade development still ongoing, and acquisition talks worth following.
